children: Russian energy company Novatek has fully worked out the redirection of liquefied natural gas supplies from the European Union market, with most going to China, the Interfax news agency cited the company's CEO as saying on Wednesday.
Leonid Mikhelson also said Novatek has signed a contract to supply LNG to Turkey, according to the newswire.

title: Russia's Novatek says it will reroute most LNG to China from the EU, Ifx reports
